method: Coordinator confirmed (at full resolution) that DSC09435 is a serve toss and the shipped alt_text said 'sets' — 3 of 10 sampled alt texts named a wrong action verb. Fixed the alt_text instruction in three iterations, each re-run against the real model on the same 10 DWdCET (Milliken at North Central) photos and re-graded by reading every source image at FULL resolution (not the downscaled cache). Iteration 1 (name a play only when unambiguous, with definitions per play) did NOT stop the errors: DSC09432 (a set/tip at the net) and DSC09435 (a serve, confirmed by the coordinator) both still asserted 'serves'/'sets' confidently and wrongly at full resolution. Iteration 2 removed play-naming entirely — alt_text now describes only visible body position/motion toward the ball ('reaches overhead for the ball'), never asserting which of serve/set/spike/attack/block/dig/pass it is. This produced 0/10 false action-verb claims, but introduced a new defect: the model defaulted to appending 'near the net' as generic filler even when no net was visible in the frame (confirmed false at full resolution on DSC09426, 09427, 09435, and 09438 — none show a net). Iteration 3 (final) removed 'near the net' from the example phrases and added an explicit instruction to name a setting detail only when that specific detail is actually visible, never as generic filler. Re-ran and re-graded at full resolution: 0/10 false action-verb claims, 0/10 false setting claims, 10/10 alt-text-contract clean (inspectAltText, using each photo's own real visible_text). One residual, minor imprecision recorded, not fixed: DSC09440's alt_text ('reaches toward the ball') describes a pointing/reacting gesture during what looks like a stoppage — no ball is clearly visible in that specific frame — a body-motion description that may be imprecise, but not a specific false claim about identity, a digit, a name, printed text, or a named play. Also found and fixed, earlier in this session: scripts/ingest-album.ts's photo_metadata upsert never wrote alt_text (now included), and the named-text cross-check's stoplist (single-word, then multi-word) needed correction against real production visible_text frequency data.
scope: 10 DWdCET/Milliken photos, real model, three prompt iterations, each re-graded at full resolution
